description: [GAVI] Gavi-supported immunisation generated more than US$ 30 billion in economic benefits in 2025, through lower healthcare costs and healthier, more productive populations Recognising the value of immunisation, countries invested a record US$ 301 million in co-financing of Gavi-supported vaccines in 2025 Dr Sania Nishtar, Gavi CEO: "When it comes to immunisation we know that the return on investment extends far beyond health to supporting sustainable, inclusive economic growth."
title: Africa: Vaccines Deliver Over U.S.$30 Billion in Economic Benefits for Lower-Income Countries in 2025

description: [Daily Maverick] Africa's reliance on industrial agriculture reflects colonialism, inequality, and the erasure of indigenous knowledge, while intensive farming has driven soil degradation, environmental harm, poor nutrition and economic exploitation. Restoring agricultural sovereignty requires reclaiming indigenous knowledge, addressing land inequalities, and shifting toward regenerative 'landculture' centred on soil health, biodiversity, food security and community wellbeing.

description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Africa is off track to meet its malaria reduction targets, with climate change, biological resistance, shrinking donor funding and inadequate intervention coverage threatening efforts to eliminate the disease by 2030, the World Health Organization has warned.

description: [RFI] Wildlife populations monitored across Africa have declined by an average of 80 percent over the past five decades, according to a major new assessment by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF), which warns that changes to energy, food and financial systems are essential to reversing biodiversity loss.

title: Africa: Neofleet Capital Raises $4m for African Taxi Fleets

description: [Daba Finance] Lighthouse Capital, an operator-led private equity firm, is actively raising a US$50 million private equity fund. This new fund is specifically designed to target high-growth mid-market businesses across South Africa and Kenya. The firm aims to combine long-term investment capital with hands-on operational expertise, focusing on sectors vital to the region's economic development.
title: Africa: Lighthouse Capital to Raise $50m for Mid-Market Africa Fund

description: [Daba Finance] The African Union has named South Africa's Sifiso Falala interim chief executive officer of the Africa Credit Rating Agency, or AfCRA, as the continent starts a new institution designed to assess sovereigns, companies and public bodies. Falala is the founder and CEO of Sovereign Africa Ratings, a South African ratings firm that has assessed countries including Ghana, Uganda and South Africa.
title: Africa: African Union Names Sifiso Falala Interim CEO of Credit Rating Agency
